اعتصمتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَمْتُنَّ (iʕtaṣamtunna) /iʕ.ta.sˤam.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
# اُعْتُصِمْتُنَّ (uʕtuṣimtunna) /uʕ.tu.sˤim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَمَ (iʕtaṣama)
